layout.hierarchy: Confusion matrix panels and ROC plot are visually dominant. Red threshold header bars stand out against white panel backgrounds. Body text is black sans-serif. Header text in red boxes is white. Slide number is yellow accent.

visual_elements.description: Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.0: 2x2 grid with headers 'Predicted as', 'P', 'N', row labels 'Actual', 'P', 'N'. Cells: P row: 5, 0. N row: 6, 0. Adjacent text: TPR=5/(5+0)=1, FPR=6/(6+0)=1.
Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.6: 2x2 grid. Cells: P row: 3, 1. N row: 1, 5. Adjacent text: TPR=3/(3+1)=0.6, FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16.
Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.1: 2x2 grid. Cells: P row: 5, 0. N row: 4, 2. Adjacent text: TPR=5/(5+0)=1, FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66.
Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.3: 2x2 grid. Cells: P row: 5, 0. N row: 2, 4. Adjacent text: TPR=5/(5+0)=1, FPR=2/(2+4)=0.33.
Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.4: 2x2 grid. Cells: P row: 4, 1. N row: 1, 5. Adjacent text: TPR=4/(4+1)=4/5, FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16.

ROC curve plot. Y-axis labeled TPR, X-axis labeled FPR. Light blue background with grid. Red circular data points. Labeled boxes: 0.3 (top left), 0.1 (top center), 0.0 (top right), 0.4 (middle left), 0.6 (lower left). Arrow on Y-axis pointing up, arrow on X-axis pointing right.
Gray box with text 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'

Small confusion matrix legend: headers 'Predicted as', 'P', 'N', row labels 'Actual', 'P', 'N'. Cells: TP (top left, red border), FN (top right), FP (bottom left, red border), TN (bottom right, green border).

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Threshold headers are white bold text on red background. Body text is black. Axis labels and matrix labels are black. No italics visible. Numbers in matrices are black.
animation_state: Static slide, no visible animation builds.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Add yellow circle with '33' at top-right corner.
3. Create left column with four stacked panels, each with red header bar showing 'Threshold=0.0', 'Threshold=0.1', 'Threshold=0.3', 'Threshold=0.4' in white text.
4. In each left panel, add a 2x2 confusion matrix with headers 'Predicted as', 'P', 'N' and row labels 'Actual', 'P', 'N'. Fill cells as: Threshold=0.0: [5,0; 6,0]; Threshold=0.1: [5,0; 4,2]; Threshold=0.3: [5,0; 2,4]; Threshold=0.4: [4,1; 1,5].
5. Add TPR and FPR calculation text to the right of each left panel matrix.
6. Add top-right panel with red header 'Threshold=0.6', matrix [3,1; 1,5], and text TPR=3/(3+1)=0.6, FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16.
7. Add gray box at bottom center-right with text 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'.
8. Create ROC curve plot on far right: light blue background, Y-axis 'TPR' with upward arrow, X-axis 'FPR' with rightward arrow, grid lines. Add red circular points and label boxes: 0.3, 0.1, 0.0 across top; 0.4 middle left; 0.6 lower left.
9. Add bottom-right corner section with formulas: 'TPR = TP / (TP + FN)' and 'FPR = FP / (FP + TN)'.
10. Add small confusion matrix legend below formulas with cells TP (red border), FN, FP (red border), TN (green border).
